notes.title: Try our beta with the new user interface!
notes.content:
We are improving GizmoVR player daily, so that more and more people could surf the web and watch video in VR.

Our team is always looking for ways to improve. Based on your feedback, we've updated the player and today we invite you to try it.

Your feedback matters. So, if you want to help us improve GizmoVR, please try this version and let us know what you think. Please, post your suggestions, bug reports and ideas in this topic: https://steamcommunity.com/app/768100/discussions/0/1637543304831996004/

[u]How to participate: [/u]

[list]
[*] Follow to Library -> GizmoVR -> Properties -> Betas
[*] Enter beta access code: gizmovrbetaui
[/list]


Yours,

GizmoVR Team

tags.feature: Try our beta with the new user interface!

notes.title: GizmoVR v1.0.8 Update + Patch Released
notes.content:
General fixes and improvements:[list]
   [*]Bugfix: wrong frame packing for YouTube videos
[/list]Browser improvements:[list]
   [*]Added support for pop-ups
   [*]New tab opens in the current window
   [*]Bugfix: browser cannot be launched if application path contains Unicode characters

[/list]Virtual desktop usability improvements:[list]

[/list]Player improvements:[list]
   [*]Bugfix: failure to turn off video stereo mode
   [*]Added support for VLC libraries
   [*]Now if the video cannot be played back, the player will try to re-open it in different quality
   [*]Added support for .flv and .wmv formats
   [*]Bugfix: error when trying to run subtitles in Chinese, Japanese and Russian
   [*]The player now remembers the previously selected audio track for video
[/list]Camera module improvements:[list]
   [*]Bugfix: automatic camera hide
   [*]Bugfix: launch error after app restarts
[/list]

notes.title: GizmoVR v1.0.1 Released
notes.content:
[u]General fixes and improvements:[/u]
[list]
[*]If gaze is concentrated on the controller (Vive Controller or Oculus Touch) for some time, then brief button reference info is shown.
[*]View recentering button added to the main room
[*]Input system for Vive Controller redesigned. Use clicking in specific areas of the controller trackpad instead of swipe.
[*]Bugfix: incorrect display of the integrated browser if no internet connection is available.
[/list]

[u]Media library improvements:[/u]
[list]
[*]Added notification for access error if user attempts to open a folder that does not exist or for which user has no access rights.
[/list]

[u]Player improvements:[/u][list]
[*]Added video quality dropdown list
[*]View recentering button added to the settings window
[*]Preview for previous and next videos now contains title and runtime info 
[*]Bugfix: playback of audio from previous video.[/list]

[u]Virtual desktop usability improvements:[/u][list]
[*]Optimized performance and render quality of virtual desktop
[*]Smoothing effect for controller jitter added to virtual desktop mode
[*]App window hides automatically when switching to virtual desktop. To display the window simply exit the desktop mode or remove VR headset.[/list]

[u]Camera module improvements:[/u][list]
[*]Bugfix: unable to hide camera preview.[/list]

tags.feature: View recentering button added to the main room
Input system for Vive Controller redesigned. Use clicking in specific areas of the controller trackpad instead of swipe.

tags.bug: Bugfix: incorrect display of the integrated browser if no internet connection is available.

View recentering button added to the settings window
Preview for previous and next videos now contains title and runtime info

tags.bug: Bugfix: playback of audio from previous video.

tags.feature: Optimized performance and render quality of virtual desktop
Smoothing effect for controller jitter added to virtual desktop mode
App window hides automatically when switching to virtual desktop. To display the window simply exit the desktop mode or remove VR headset.

tags.bug: Bugfix: unable to hide camera preview.
